text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Alright. Looks like we haven't forgotten 
anything.

...This year's summer training camp is 
finally drawing to a close.

Ikuno Dictus has achieved tremendous 
growth over the course of this training 
camp...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back, Trainer. Back to the 
academy.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...I'm looking forward to autumn.

And so, leaving the camp behind with a 
solid sense of progress, we returned to 
the academy—
—A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...? That voice just now—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: —You big idiot, Teioooo!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ms. Turbo...!? What on earth happened...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I'm gonna gooo...—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Teio is... Teio is...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Calm down. First, please tell me what 
happened."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Teio-san has... given up on running...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo told Teio, "I got way stronger at 
summer camp!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
And so, I asked: "If I win the All Comers, 
will you race me?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teio, you said you'd make a comeback right 
away... So Turbo thought you'd race with 
me once I got stronger... I really thought 
that, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Saying incomprehensible things like, 'I'm 
not gonna run anymore,' or 'Give up on 
racing me'...!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
She was saying things that didn't sound 
like Teio at all, and that made Turbo 
super mad—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
And then Teio got mad, saying things like, 
"No means no!" and "There's no way you can 
win!"...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"She just didn't act like Teio at all! So 
Turbo told her straight up!!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"I'm definitely gonna win the All Comers 
by a landslide!" she said!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "Don't you dare say you're giving up!!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "...I see. To think that happened..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Teio-san... I don't know what happened, 
but... You're still—)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Alright, Turbo's going in!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where to—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Training!! I'm gonna run my heart out so 
I can blow away the All Comers!! Whatever 
it takes, let's do thisーー!!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Kh, please wait! Turbo-san!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Don't stop me, Ikuno! Turbo's gotta get a 
whole lot stronger--

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Just going through the motions won't make 
you stronger.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You must figure out what needs to be done 
before training.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ikuno...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (......I can't just leave it alone.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Please let me help, Turbo-san.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"So that you can face the All Comers in 
your strongest possible condition."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: H-Huh?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
“Still... but Ikuno, you're also entering 
the All Comers—”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. I will run in the All Comers as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...However, that does not mean I'll hand 
over victory.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I want to compete with you in the All 
Comers when your Turbo Engine is running 
at its hottest. ...That is all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"This is purely a proposal to ensure a 
fair fight. I will cooperate while making 
sure to keep proper boundaries."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —And that is the whole story.

Ikuno Dictus shared an episode that 
happened with Twin Turbo earlier today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I'm truly sorry for proceeding with such 
matters on my own without consulting you."
choice_data_list:
...You just couldn't leave them alone, 
could you?

...You just couldn't leave them alone, 
could you?

text_block_list.text:
It wasn't hard to imagine what Ikuno 
Dictus was thinking when she decided to 
lend Twin Turbo a hand.
choice_data_list:
You're worried about Twin Turbo... and 
Teio too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...If she had been satisfied, saying she 
had 'accomplished it all', I wouldn't have 
stepped in."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"However, when I spoke with Teio-san 
before, she still... hadn't accomplished 
it."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Just like many Umamusume in the past, I 
felt as though she, too, was forced to 
stop running against her will...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what feelings led Teio-san to 
tell Turbo-san that she was 'giving up.' 
However—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If your feeling of not having accomplished 
anything makes you give up on everything 
before finishing, I can't just nod and let 
that slide.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I want to equally cherish that pure desire 
to "save them no matter what" when seeing 
someone on the verge of giving up—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I know it is my ego talking. Even so, I 
simply cannot—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
choice_data_list:
Saying it's fine to just let your ego 
show...

text_block_list.text:
In the end, Ikuno Dictus's ego boils down 
to: "I want everyone to keep running," and 
"I want everyone to be rewarded for their 
efforts."

I believe this world, and our future, 
needs such an endlessly kind form of 
egoism.

text_block_list.text:
...And I feel the same way. I just want 
Twin Turbo and Tokai Teio to find 
happiness out on the turf.
choice_data_list:
However, as your Trainer, I will lead you 
to victory.

text_block_list.text:
"...This is the absolute best push I can 
give you as your Trainer."

In that case, it might end up being a

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Trainer...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ............Thank you very much.

"Heading toward the All Comers, something 
was beginning to move..."
